projects.intervention_detail: Five women with asymptomatic bacterial vaginosis, untreated at baseline, were each given a 1-week course of oral metronidazole after baseline assessment and at every subsequent 2-monthly visit at which they tested BV-positive over 12 months (20 swabs).

papers.title: Effect of metronidazole on vaginal microbiota associated with asymptomatic bacterial vaginosis.
